description: QC Technician Position Summary The QC Technician supports quality control testing activities for raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products within a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Business & Data Analyst Consultant We are not accepting C2C or 1099 arrangements. Location: Minneapolis, MN (Preferred), Charlotte, NC, Dallas, TX Employment Type: Contract / Consultant About the Role We are seeking a highly analytical Business & Data Analyst Consultant to support enterprise data and analytics initiatives within a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environment. In this role, you will partner with business stakeholders, product managers, data consumers, and technology teams to transform business needs into actionable data insights and reporting solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis expertise with advanced data analysis skills and a passion for data quality, governance, and decision support. This position focuses on business and data analysis and does not include application development, data engineering, cloud administration, or database administration responsibilities. What You'll Do Gather, analyze, and document business, functional, and data requirements across enterprise initiatives. Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, opportunities, and data quality concerns. Conduct data profiling, validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities to ensure accuracy and consistency. Translate complex business objectives into clear reporting, analytics, and data requirements. Partner with product, governance, business, and technology teams to investigate and resolve data-related issues.
